scope: Open document-comparison, offer coverage, verification and source-access work. Tasks are ordered by priority, then intended work order; blocked/external items require their stated prerequisite. Regression fixtures accompany each parser fix. Completed checks are recorded in docs/VERIFICATION.md, not retained here.
sourceStrategy: Decision of 26 September: cover selected useful official sources, not every provider or offer. Do not schedule weekly checks or chase routine page and promotion changes. Maintain an adapter when a real failure affects supported offers; consider new providers or variants only for an explicit product priority and a sufficiently stable official source. Prefer official structured feeds or documents when available. If access or parsing fails, show the source warning and official link without inventing prices. On-demand data refresh does not imply weekly parser development.
